h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Allahabad

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Allahabad

items.pText: Allahabad, now officially Prayagraj, is a city of courts, government offices, universities and coaching institutes, and many of its playground buyers are public bodies. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Allahabad to municipal parks, government and institutional campuses, schools and housing colonies. Our factory in Vasai is about 1,140 km away, and we send each order by road and install it with our own team or a dealer.

Public buyers need paperwork as much as equipment. Before an order is placed, a park or campus committee usually wants to see what will go where, how much space it takes and what the warranty covers. Our layout drawing answers the first two, with the safe play area marked around each piece. The written warranty answers the third. On the ground, plan for very hot summers and for the monsoon on the flat plains near the Ganga and Yamuna, where low-lying parks can hold water after heavy rain.

richText.heading: Buying for a public park or government campus

c: Public parks get heavy use, often from morning till late evening, by children of every age. Choose sturdy pieces that several children can use at once, such as a
, double swings and a multi play system. Spread them out so crowds do not gather in one spot.

items.q: Can you provide a layout drawing for committee approval?
items.a: Yes. Share the park or campus dimensions, the age groups and photos. We send a layout drawing showing each piece and its safe play area, along with the quote, before anything is manufactured.

items.q: Which equipment suits a busy public park in Prayagraj?
items.a: Pieces that many children can use at the same time, such as merry-go-rounds, double swings, see-saws and multi play systems. Spreading them across the park reduces crowding around any one piece.

items.q: What happens if the park floods during the monsoon?
items.a: We suggest raising the play area slightly and grouting posts into concrete. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are weather-proof, but drainage should be planned before installation.
